body:
Integrates the offline AI-search foundation on main: parser/fact pipeline, all 15 typed hard criteria, current-source proof guards before count/order/seek/limit, existing public eligibility/cards/gallery/TOP order, signed owned cursors and atomic text execution with session CAS, result receipt and quota debit. No public AI activation or default provider.

### Correctness and privacy boundaries

- Canonical listing/room state is bound into proof signatures. Confirmed price, mode, capacity, availability and free-place facts must agree with current canonical values; unknown room occupancy cannot become free inventory. The semantic verifier version is signed, so older cached proofs cannot bypass stronger checks.
- Idempotency binds the complete validated card payload. Changed filters conflict without further inference/debit; equivalent defaults, UUIDs and polygon normalization replay safely. Legacy quota-only fingerprints are preserved.
- Reconcile repairs corrupt deterministic projections. The bridge explicitly declares its supported provider subset and admits reviewed structured evidence without requiring a description.
- Hidden HTML blocks close in stack order; malformed hidden boundaries remain suppressed. Nested nav/header/footer cannot expose outer hidden content.
- Pagination is explicitly **live keyset**. Each page rechecks source/public eligibility and TOP order in its own database snapshot. The proof-set identity is a prepared-cache identity, not a frozen result set. Changes can alter totals/order; refresh discovers newly eligible rows before the seek point. Regression tests cover source mutations/restoration, moderation, owner blocking and promotion reordering.

[Detailed contracts, repeat-review resolution, coverage matrix and release gates](https://github.com/antony502189-max/Ttest/blob/3db07f7dfedc36d0e9ebf62f9fc104ae06d6034c/docs/ai-search-developer/PR_392_REVIEW_RESOLUTION.md).

- PR400-03: owned paginated list_for_user plus authenticated metadata GET /saved-searches/ai and desktop/mobile collection management. Metadata has no criteria, uses private/no-store, and remains listable/deletable above the creation cap. Existing owned DELETE frees slots. No AI save/provider/delivery endpoint is activated.
- PR400-04: save/read/dry-run validate criteria against both current session and pipeline vocabularies; divergence/drift produces SAVED_AI_STATE_INVALID before matching or writes.
- PR400-05: snapshot DTO includes matcher and normalized name through save/get/set_enabled.
- PR400-06: unreleased migration0074 refuses schema downgrade without changing stamp/data; production safety rejects downgrade commands in deploy/rollback/Compose. Binary-only rollback/redeploy documented and tested with actual Alembic.
- PR400-07: rollback-overcap policy preserves all rows, permits paginated management/deletion and rejects new saves until below cap; real old-binary-style SQL writes followed by current management are tested.

Additional review fixed UUID subclass handling for PostgreSQL pagination and a visually verified narrow-screen action clipping issue. The final browser regression uses a long saved name and asserts complete delete-button bounds at 320/1280px. The migration remains expand-compatible with immutable released history; 0074 follows 0073 and adds only a defaulted manual discriminator plus new tables. Snapshot save/replay still needs one pool checkout and retains ownership/version/hash guards and shared AI/manual cap.

body:
A sparse AI map viewport previously scanned unrelated external-source catalog rows for every proof candidate. Resolve the deduplicated UNION of current/former source IDs through existing indexes, then read authority rows by ID. Preserve `query-proof.v2`, ordering, the 129/1025 bounds and fail-closed remap/delete/new-source invalidation.

The capacity toolchain now uses evidence protocol `r01-capacity.v2` and addresses the additional review of HEAD `1a8975b3`:

- **N01/N02:** report seed, load, baseline, plans, resources, dataset stability, full protocol and SLO separately. COMPLETE requires the entire baseline matrix, every captured query's valid actual/estimated plan, complete resource coverage, and all three scales. Missing/contradictory evidence returns a nonzero summary CLI status with a reviewable report.
- **N04:** an OS output lock records owner run/PID; a database-wide advisory lock excludes concurrent phases across experiments. During measure, SHARE locks freeze every lab-schema table from preflight through query/pool cleanup, blocking DML/TRUNCATE/DDL from other writers. Seed generation is attested before/after the frozen interval.
- **N05/N06:** validate raw UTC/monotonic durations, seconds, timing components, success counts/items and failure diagnoses. Capture every explicit SQL dispatch, including WITH/comment queries, with an explicitly marked transaction-control statement. Match ordered capture/plan counts, SQL SHA-256 and binds. Retain both EXPLAIN failures as failed evidence instead of silently dropping plans.
- **N07/N08:** dataset file presence is separate from seed attestation; validate all nine counts, provider count, exact proof sample ordinals, generation and completed init/seed manifests. The historical report now explicitly labels old attempts as unverified by the current protocol; raw/ZIP evidence is unchanged.
- **N09:** extend the actual full-schema map test with 32/128/300/301 candidates at zoom 8/13 and 2,048 unrelated sources. Record/bound authority node types, total loops, visited rows and buffer touches through marker/probe/cluster paths.
- **N10:** retain the existing mobile dialog synchronization fix because it removes a race in mandatory Mobile validation CI; its scope is explicitly documented in the resolution.

**N03 remains an open public-release gate.** Small deterministic plans are not p95/p99 or capacity measurements. No new 100k/500k/1m load was run, and no public AI activation is authorized or enabled. New large measurements still need separate owner authorization.

Validation on remediation commit `b21f9ade81027fd24c4b1fca09f9723413c74185`: 1,559 local backend unit tests passed with 15 expected skips; 59 selected real PostgreSQL tests passed (20 toolchain and 39 proof), plus the expanded full-schema map regression. The unit total includes 152 toolchain/isolation tests, including real Windows PowerShell/fake-Docker and cross-process output locking. Counts overlap. Ruff app/tests/scripts, mypy (153 application files), Bandit medium/high, pip-audit of the pinned Python graph and supply-chain pin validation passed. All 10 applicable GitHub Actions workflows passed on this exact HEAD: [AI parser data foundation](https://github.com/antony502189-max/Ttest/actions/runs/40937993627), [Payment audit](https://github.com/antony502189-max/Ttest/actions/runs/40937993605), [Security dependency and static audit](https://github.com/antony502189-max/Ttest/actions/runs/40937993638), [Capacity smoke safeguards](https://github.com/antony502189-max/Ttest/actions/runs/40937993582), [Audit Source Snapshot](https://github.com/antony502189-max/Ttest/actions/runs/40937993688), [Full audit](https://github.com/antony502189-max/Ttest/actions/runs/40937993630), [AI Search backend quota and sessions](https://github.com/antony502189-max/Ttest/actions/runs/40937993628), [AI Search combined facts quota sessions](https://github.com/antony502189-max/Ttest/actions/runs/40937993587), [Production audit](https://github.com/antony502189-max/Ttest/actions/runs/40937993600), [Mobile validation](https://github.com/antony502189-max/Ttest/actions/runs/40937993590). GitHub reports the PR mergeable with no conflicts against main.

See [review resolution](https://github.com/antony502189-max/Ttest/blob/b21f9ade81027fd24c4b1fca09f9723413c74185/docs/ai-search-developer/PR_401_TOOLCHAIN_REVIEW_RESOLUTION.md) and [protocol](https://github.com/antony502189-max/Ttest/blob/b21f9ade81027fd24c4b1fca09f9723413c74185/docs/ai-search-developer/MAP_CAPACITY_PROTOCOL.md). The prior R01–R08 fixes remain included.

Historical evidence: 100k has 18 scenarios/3,600 failed attempts; 500k has 18 scenarios/2,100 failed attempts; 1m remains unmeasured. Those attempts describe the original OR SQL and do not certify current protocol completion or post-fix capacity.

Work used only small synthetic fixtures in a disposable test container. No application/staging/production DB, real provider/ASR, paid API, notification, public activation or deployment was used. The SQL change adds no migration, dependency, API or UI behavior; activation gates remain closed.
